div.div: 6 تناهضوا فِى الحَرْبِ (S, A, Mgh, K) They rose, one with another, or one against another, and withstood, or opposed, one another. in war. or battle: (Mgh,) or each party of them rose and hastened (نَهَضَ) to, or towards, the other, in war. or battle. (S, K. *) See also 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
